setup_aws_credentials: setup AWS credentials for an MTurk requester profile by writing access keys to the AWS credentials file
create_hit_type: create an MTurk HIT type with a title, reward, duration, and locale or qualification requirements
create_hit_with_hit_type: create an MTurk HIT from an existing HIT type pointing workers to an external page URL
find_or_create_qualification: find an existing MTurk qualification type by name or create a new one if it does not exist
pay_bonus: pay a bonus amount to an MTurk worker for a completed assignment with a reason and unique token
